up: Retrieve the ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested against the human target Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK4). Return one row per compound with its ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'Interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
